title: You’re Using Claude Code Wrong! (Use Skills Instead)
description:
If you’re using Claude Code without Skills, you’re missing a huge part of what makes it powerful.

A new library now gives you access to 100,000+ ready-made AI Skills that can instantly turn Claude into a specialist for specific tasks.

You can find Skills for:

• UI Design
• App Development
• SEO Research
• Lead Generation

• Marketing
